description:
[Format-preserving synthetic data generator. Deterministic synthesis, read-only, side-effect free]. Generates mathematically valid European synthetic mock records (valid Codice Fiscale format, checksum-valid IBANs, realistic names, companies, and phone numbers) to completely replace real personal datasets under GDPR Recital 26.
Usage: Use this tool to anonymize tabular/JSON training corpora, test datasets, and staging databases with format-faithful synthetic data.
Returns: JSON object with { recordCount: number, fieldsProcessed: array, syntheticData: array, gdprRecital26Compliant: boolean, irreversibleAnonymization: boolean }.

fieldsToMask.description: Specific field names to replace with synthetic mock values

records.description: Array of raw tabular/JSON records to be masked

name: eu_synthetic_data_masker
title: Format-Preserving European Synthetic Data Generator
